general.title: QC filter options
general.instructions: Every field is optional — the defaults are a sensible QC pass for the instrument demo data. Each reading gets exactly one reason, applied in this order: dropped instrument, low coverage, out of range, flatline, spike, ok. A value that cannot be read logs a warning and skips that one rule; the run always finishes.

parameters.name: Minimum valid reading
parameters.description: Readings below this value are flagged out_of_range. Blank means no lower bound.

parameters.name: Maximum valid reading
parameters.description: Readings above this value are flagged out_of_range. Blank means no upper bound.

parameters.name: Spike threshold (MAD multiples)
parameters.description: Robust z = 0.6745*(x-median)/MAD, computed per instrument after out-of-range rows are removed. Readings above this many MAD multiples are flagged spike. 0 disables the rule.

parameters.name: Flatline run length
parameters.description: A run of this many identical consecutive readings from one instrument is a stuck sensor; the whole run is flagged flatline. Must be 2 or more.

parameters.name: Minimum instrument coverage %
parameters.description: Coverage is observed readings divided by the expected hourly slots between an instrument's first and last timestamp. Instruments below this percentage are dropped entirely. Must be between 0 and 100.

parameters.name: Drop instruments
parameters.description: Comma-separated instrument ids to force-drop regardless of their data quality, e.g. RX-102, RX-103. Blank keeps every instrument.
